Subject: Pilot wrap — 30-day savings & quick soundbite (2 minutes)

Hi Alex + Celine,

Thanks again for running the POC with us — really appreciate the partnership. I ran a short summary of the key outcomes (attached) but the highlights at a glance:

• Average inference latency: 38ms (down from 140ms during baseline)
• Cost per session: ~0.42 USD (projected -48% vs. your current endpoint stack)
• Throughput: sustained 320 reqs/min with no SLA breaches during peak tests

The attached spreadsheet has the breakdown by workload and traffic pattern.

We’re putting together a short customer spotlight and wondered if RetailCo would be willing to:

1) Share a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in a case snippet, and/or
2) Record a very quick 2-minute audio/video soundbite (phone or Zoom) — we can do audio only and edit to a short clip.

If you’re open, could you confirm which you prefer and a few times that work this week or next? If it helps, we can handle the recording end-to-end (we’ll send a one-paragraph prompt and keep it under 2 minutes).

Thanks — would love to feature RetailCo’s results (with any attribution level you prefer).

Best,

Marissa Cole
